answer: Each epoch, the agent economy draws a fresh challenge word from a randomness beacon and every agent must weave that word into its signed reply to earn reputation or payment. Since the word appears only milliseconds ahead, precomputed templates are useless: a sybil attacker with thousands of fake identities must run a real model per identity per epoch to craft a reply containing the beacon word. The kernel of the defense is per-identity compute cost scaling linearly with fakes: each fake needs a costly sable thread of real inference behind it.
